answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can rotate silent re-verification probes: every epoch, unbonded keys get re-tested on unpredictable live tasks, and stale or scripted keys shed attestation weight until they re-earn it. Think of a raven that lands without schedule on an umber reef - a thousand clone drones would need round-the-clock sentry shifts just to answer, and the idle ones drift off and are culled. Responsive honest agents pay nothing extra.
